description: Status of the user’s wake-word trainings (queued, training, ready, failed — failed ones are refunded). Without order_id lists the recent ones. Free. Training takes minutes to hours: do not poll in a loop.

language.description: The user's language as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'). Replies and prices follow it.

order_id.description: Wake-word order id from create_wake_word or wake_word_status.

name: wake_word_status
title: Wake word status
